listeners.doc: SAP JCo server that receives inbound IDocs and RFC calls from the SAP system and dispatches each to the attached IDocService or RfcService instance.

acquisition.note: Download sapidoc3.jar from the SAP Service Marketplace. Licensed, not resolvable from any public Maven repository.
Download sapjco3.jar from the SAP Service Marketplace, together with the native library for each OS you deploy to. Licensed, not resolvable from any public Maven repository.

serviceTypes.doc: Receives inbound IDocs dispatched from the SAP system to this server.
Receives inbound RFC calls dispatched from the SAP system for registered function modules on this server.
